uncited: Common steps include sampling means within the camera frustum, initializing opacity to low values ($0.01$–$0.1$) to prevent inverse-square falloff interference, and running a static warm-up phase for $2,000$ iterations [Gaussian Initialization and Warm-up](9657-gaussian-initialization-and-warm-up.md).
Voxel-based variants average attributes within voxels and use the largest volume covariance [Gaussian Initialization and Warm-up](9657-gaussian-initialization-and-warm-up.md).

Motion-blur variants dynamically calculate supplementing point counts based on bounding box volume and interpolate colors from nearest neighbors [Supplementing Points for Camera Motion Blur](12327-supplementing-points-for-camera-motion-blur.md).
